title: Trying to buy something
content: In my Mallworld dreams i always try to by comic books and can't choose what to buy. And this dream haunts me for at least two years. In first iterations of these dreams it was a small shop, but now it's a pretty big mall, and I remember at least 2-3 comic book shops there. And I STILL can't buy anything. I'm confused what it could mean tbh and I had these dreams 10 times at least
